[P1] 安野光雅“美丽的数学”系列
奇妙的种子
[日]安野光雅 著·绘
艾茗 译

九州出版社
JIUZHOU PRESS

[P2] 奇妙的种子
[日] 安野光雅 著·绘
艾茗 译
中国城市出版社
·北京·

[P3] 很久很久以前，在某个地方住着一个懒惰的男人。
有一年的冬天，
当这个男人正望着天空发呆的时候，
来了一位仙人。
仙人对他说：“我给你两颗奇妙的种子吧。你把其中一颗烤烤吃掉的话，一整年你都不会觉得肚子饿。另外的一颗把它埋在地里，来年的秋天一定能收获两颗种子的。”
说完就给了他两颗奇妙的种子。

[P4] 这个男人把其中的一颗种子
烤熟之后吃下去了。原本金色的
种子烤熟之后变成了红色。这颗
种子的味道好极了。而且，正如
仙人所说的那样，只要吃一颗下
去，肚子就变得饱饱的。
男人把另外一颗种子埋在了
地里。第二年的春天，长出了可
爱的新芽。
秋天到了，正如仙人说的那样，
果真收获了两颗种子。
到了夏天，开出了美丽的花朵。
冬天，男人把其中的一颗种子烤熟吃掉之后，
把剩下的一颗埋在了土里。

[P5] 春天，
种子发芽了。

秋天到了。
又收获了两颗种子。

夏天，
美丽的花儿开了。

冬天，男人烤熟了其中的一颗种子吃下去，
把另外的一颗埋到了土里。

[P6] 第二年，同样开花，同样收获了两颗种子。
这个男人同样吃掉了烤熟的一颗，把另外一颗埋入土里。
再过一年，一样的开花，一样的长出了两颗种子。
男人吃掉了一颗种子，把另外一颗埋入土里。

[P7] 隔年，一样的开花，一样的结出了两颗种子。
男人一样的吃掉了一颗种子，再把另一颗埋入土里。
再隔一年，一样的开花，一样的长出了两颗种子。
男人一样的吃掉了一颗种子，再把另一颗埋入土里。

[P8] 这个男人终于意识到了问题。他心想：“这样下去的话，不论过多久都是重复同样的生活。不如今年把两颗种子都埋在地里，然后找点别的东西吃，凑合一下吧。”
那一年的冬天，男人果真把珍藏的两颗种子细心地种在了地里。

[P9] 下一年（也就是改变之后的第一年），你猜会有什么不一样的事发生呢？春天发芽，到了秋天收获了四颗种子！男人烤了其中的一颗种子吃了，把剩下的三颗埋入了地里。

再接下来的一年（改变后的第二年），春天发芽，秋天收获了六颗种子。男人吃下了一颗种子，冬天时把剩下的五颗种子埋在了地里。

为了怕麻雀和乌鸦来偷吃，男人做了一个“鸣笛”来吓唬鸟雀。风一吹，鸣笛一响，鸟雀们就被吓飞了。

你猜，第二年的秋天能采摘多少颗种子呢？

[P10] 接下来的一年（也就是
改变之后的第三年），春天发
芽，秋天收获了十颗种子。冬
天男人种下了九颗种子。

第二年（也就是第四年），春
天发芽，秋天收获了18颗种子。冬
天，男人种下了17颗种子。

接下来的一年（也就是第五年），春天发
芽，秋天收获了很多颗种子。冬天男人吃了一
颗之后把剩下的种子全都埋在了地里。
他一共埋了多少颗种子在地里呢？

[P11] 接下来的一年（第六年），那一年的秋天收获了好多颗种子，多得简直数不清。采摘种子的工作忙得不可开交的时候，一个路过的女人帮了他的忙。那一年一共收获了多少颗种子呢？

男人和女人各烤了一颗种子吃下去。那一年的冬天，他们把剩下的种子都埋在了地里。

一共埋了多少颗呢？

[P12] 接下来的一年（第七年），春天发芽，秋天收获了好多颗种子。
那年冬天，两人高高兴兴地举办了结婚典礼。婚礼上来了五个朋友。
他们给每个朋友分别送了两颗种子。其中一颗是给他们带回家当礼物的。
两个人分别吃了一颗。那一年男人建了个谷仓，储藏了16颗种子。
剩下的种子全部埋在了地里。男人已经没办法再继续懒惰下去了。
他一共种了多少颗种子呢？

[P13] 接下来的一年（第八年），春天长出了好多好多的新芽，秋天收获了好多好多颗种子。
因为这一年的收成实在太好了，所以他们连同原来贮藏在谷仓的种子一起，一共运了60颗到镇上去卖。
扣除两人吃掉的两颗，重新在谷仓里贮藏了34颗种子。剩下的种子统统埋在了地里。地里一共埋了多少颗种子呢？

[P14] 接下来的一年（第九年），
春天长出了好多好多的新芽，秋天结了好多好多的种子。

他们的孩子也出生了。冬天，全家共吃了三颗种子。因为收获
的种子太多了，所以连同原来贮藏在谷仓里的种子一起，一共运了
100颗种子到镇上去卖。另外在谷仓里贮藏了51颗新种子。
然后把剩下的都埋在了地里。到底一共埋了多少颗种子呢？

[P15] 接下来的一年（第十年），秋天到了，地里结满了种子。他们的孩子长大了，房子也盖成了。就在快要收成的时候，好像开始起风了。

[P16] 啊！是暴风雨呢！好天气持续了那么久，
谁也没想到会有台风来袭。河水涨满，变成了
洪水。男人赶紧把房子绑在树上，把牛赶进车
里。车子像船一样浮在水面上。妈妈紧紧地抱
着孩子爬到了顶楼上。他们好不容易才把装满
了珍贵的种子的袋子绑在了树上。
暴风雨真可怕呀！大树在狂风中摇晃，雨滴噼噼啪啪地扑打在人的脸上。浑浊的河
水咆哮着奔涌而去，大地变成了一片汪洋。田里的农作物被冲走了，谷仓也被冲散了。

[P17] 可怕的暴风雨终于停了。天空开始放晴。暴风雨过后的景象真是惨不忍睹。
妈妈说：“咱们家孩子没事真是太好了。”
“真是太好了。而且耕牛也平安无事，十颗种子没有被冲走。那我们打起精神从头再来吧。”爸爸也说道。

[P18] 他们吃掉了三颗种子，然后把剩下的种在了地里。
他们虔诚地向上天祈求：“老天啊，请千万保佑我们今年丰收吧。”
full_text_en:
[P1] Mitsumasa Anno's "Beautiful Mathematics" Series
The Magical Seed
By and Illustrated by Mitsumasa Anno
Translated by Ai Ming

Jiu Zhou Press
JIUZHOU PRESS

[P2] The Wonderful Seed
[Japan] Mitsumasa Anno, Author & Illustrator
Yi Ming, Translator
China City Publishing House
·Beijing·

[P3] Long, long ago, in some place, there lived a lazy man.
One winter,
when the man was staring blankly at the sky,
a fairy appeared.
The fairy said to him: "I'll give you two magical seeds. If you roast and eat one of them, you won't feel hungry all year. If you bury the other one in the ground, you'll surely harvest two seeds next autumn."
Then, the fairy gave him the two magical seeds.

[P4] This man ate one of the seeds after roasting it. The originally golden seed turned red after roasting. The seed tasted wonderful. And, just as the fairy said, eating just one made his stomach feel full.
He planted the other seed in the ground. In the spring of the following year, a cute sprout grew.
Autumn came, and just as the fairy said, he truly harvested two seeds.
By summer, beautiful flowers bloomed.
In winter, the man roasted and ate one of the seeds, then planted the remaining one in the soil.

[P5] Spring,
the seed sprouted.

Autumn arrived.
He harvested two more seeds.

Summer,
beautiful flowers bloomed.

Winter, the man roasted one of the seeds and ate it,
and buried the other one in the soil.

[P6] The second year, it bloomed again and yielded two seeds.
The man ate one roasted seed and buried the other in the soil.
Another year passed, and it bloomed again, producing two seeds.
The man ate one seed and buried the other in the soil.

[P7] The following year, it bloomed as usual and bore two seeds.
The man ate one seed and buried the other in the soil.
Another year passed, it bloomed as usual and grew two seeds.
The man ate one seed and buried the other in the soil.

[P8] The man finally realized the problem. He thought: "If I keep going like this, no matter how long it takes, I'll just be repeating the same life. Maybe this year I should bury both seeds in the ground, and find something else to eat to get by." 
That winter, the man really did carefully plant the two precious seeds he had kept in the ground.

[P9] The next year (the first year after the change), what do you think will happen differently? In spring, it sprouted, and by autumn, four seeds were harvested! The man roasted one of the seeds and ate it, then buried the remaining three in the ground.

The following year (the second year after the change), it sprouted in spring and yielded six seeds in autumn. The man ate one seed and buried the remaining five in the ground during winter.

To prevent sparrows and crows from stealing the seeds, the man made a "whistle" to scare the birds. When the wind blew, the whistle sounded, and the birds flew away.

Guess how many seeds could be harvested in the autumn of the second year?

[P10] The following year (the third year after the change), in spring the seeds sprouted, and in autumn he harvested ten seeds. In winter, the man planted nine seeds.

The next year (the fourth year), in spring the seeds sprouted, and in autumn he harvested 18 seeds. In winter, the man planted 17 seeds.

The following year (the fifth year), in spring the seeds sprouted, and in autumn he harvested many seeds. In winter, the man ate one seed and then buried all the remaining seeds in the ground.
How many seeds did he bury in the ground?

[P11] The following year (the sixth year), in the autumn, they harvested many seeds, so many that they couldn't even count them. When the work of harvesting became overwhelming, a woman who passed by helped him. How many seeds were harvested that year?

The man and the woman each roasted and ate one seed. That winter, they buried the remaining seeds in the ground.

How many seeds did they bury in total?

[P12] The following year (the seventh year), the seeds sprouted in spring and yielded many seeds in autumn.
That winter, the two happily held a wedding ceremony. Five friends came to the wedding.
They gave two seeds to each friend. One of them was to be taken home as a gift.
The two each ate one seed. That year, the man built a granary and stored 16 seeds.
The remaining seeds were all buried in the ground. The man could no longer continue being lazy.
How many seeds did he plant in total?

[P13] The following year (the eighth year), spring brought many, many new sprouts, and autumn brought many, many seeds.
Because the harvest was so good, they took the seeds stored in the granary and together transported 60 seeds to town to sell.
After deducting the two seeds they ate, they stored 34 seeds back in the granary. The remaining seeds were all buried in the ground. How many seeds were buried in the ground?

[P14] The following year (the ninth year),
In spring, many, many new sprouts grew, and in autumn, many, many seeds formed.

Their child was also born. In winter, the whole family ate three seeds. Because the harvest
of seeds was so abundant, they took, together with the seeds originally stored in the granary, a total of
100 seeds to sell in town. Additionally, they stored 51 new seeds in the granary.
Then they buried the rest in the ground. How many seeds were buried in total?

[P15] The following year (the tenth year), autumn arrived, and the fields were full of seeds. Their child had grown up, and the house was finished. Just as harvest time was approaching, it seemed like the wind was starting to blow.

[P16] Ah! It's a storm! The good weather had lasted so long,
no one expected a typhoon to come. The river swelled and turned into
floodwaters. The man quickly tied the house to the tree and drove the cow into the cart.
The cart floated on the water like a boat. The mother tightly hugged the child and climbed to the top floor. They finally managed to tie the bag full of precious seeds to the tree.
The storm is terrible! The big tree swayed in the fierce wind, raindrops pattered and pounded on people's faces. The muddy river roared and surged forward, turning the land into a vast ocean. The crops in the fields were swept away, and the granary was also scattered.

[P17] The terrible storm finally stopped. The sky began to clear. The scene after the storm was heartbreaking.
Mom said, "It's so good that our child is safe."
"It's so good. And the ox is safe too, the ten seeds weren't washed away. Let's cheer up and start over," Dad said.

[P18] They ate three seeds, then planted the rest in the ground.
They sincerely prayed to heaven: "Oh, God, please protect us and grant us a bountiful harvest this year."
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《奇妙的种子》的封面，展示了书名、作者、译者和出版社信息，画面中有两个拟人化的动物角色，一个手持种子，另一个拄着拐杖，周围环绕着嫩绿的幼苗。
[P2] 本页为绘本《奇妙的种子》的封面，展示了书名、作者、译者和出版社信息，画面中有两个拟人化的动物角色，一个手持种子，另一个拄着拐杖，周围环绕着嫩绿的幼苗。
[P3] 本页讲述了很久以前，一个懒惰的男人在冬天发呆时，一位仙人出现并赠予他两颗奇妙的种子，告诉他一颗可吃以饱腹，另一颗可埋土中来年收获两颗。
[P4] 本页通过四个分镜展示了男人如何按照仙人的指示，交替食用和种植种子：他吃掉一颗种子后感到饱腹，将另一颗种下，第二年春天长出新芽，秋天收获两颗种子，夏天开花，冬天再次吃掉一颗并种下另一颗。
[P5] 本页通过四个分镜展示了种子从春天发芽、夏天开花、秋天收获到冬天再次食用和种植的完整生长循环，体现了循环种植的过程。
[P6] 本页通过两个分镜展示了种子种植的循环：第二年，植物开花并收获两颗种子，男人吃掉一颗、埋下一颗；第三年，植物再次开花并长出两颗种子，男人重复同样的行为。
[P7] 本页通过两个分镜展示了种子种植的循环：第二年，植物开花并收获两颗种子，男人吃掉一颗、埋下一颗；第三年，植物再次开花并长出两颗种子，男人重复同样的行为。
[P8] 男人意识到循环种植的局限，决定将两颗种子都种下，以改变重复的生活模式。
[P9] 本页描述了男人改变种植方式后的第一年和第二年：第一年收获四颗种子，吃掉一颗后种下三颗；第二年收获六颗种子，吃掉一颗后种下五颗，并制作了“鸣笛”来驱赶偷吃种子的鸟雀，最后以提问形式引导读者思考下一年的收获。
[P10] 本页通过三个分镜展示了男人改变种植方式后的第三、四、五年：第三年收获十颗种子并种下九颗，第四年收获十八颗种子并种下十七颗，第五年收获大量种子后吃掉一颗并全部种下，最后以提问形式引导读者思考。
[P11] 本页描述了第六年丰收的场景，男人收获大量种子，一位路过的女人前来帮忙，两人各吃一颗种子后将剩余种子全部埋入地下，并向读者提问收获和埋种的数量。
[P12] 第七年，男人和女人收获了大量种子，举办了婚礼并招待了五位朋友，每人赠送两颗种子，两人各吃一颗后，将剩余种子全部种下，并向读者提问种下的种子数量。
[P13] 第八年丰收，男人和女人将收获的种子与原有储备合并，运60颗到镇上出售，吃掉2颗，贮藏34颗，其余全部埋入地里，并向读者提问埋种数量。
[P14] 本页描述了第九年丰收的场景，一家三口收获了大量种子，冬天全家吃了三颗，将100颗运到镇上出售，51颗贮藏在谷仓，剩余的全部埋入地里，并向读者提问埋种的数量。
[P15] 本页描绘了第十个秋天，一家三口的农场丰收在望，孩子已长大，新房子也建好了，但风开始吹起，预示着即将发生的变故。
[P16] 本页描绘了突如其来的暴风雨和洪水，一家三口在危急中将房子绑在树上，把牛赶进车里，妈妈抱着孩子爬上顶楼，并将装满种子的袋子绑在树上以保安全，同时描述了洪水带来的破坏。
[P17] 暴风雨过后，一家三口检查灾情，确认孩子、耕牛和十颗种子都安然无恙，决定重新开始生活。
[P18] 一家三口在田里种下种子，吃掉了三颗，然后虔诚地向上天祈求丰收。
[P19] 本页画面展示了一片整齐排列的绿色幼苗，共二十株，象征着灾后重新播种的希望与新生。
